name: Agent network
summary: Your agent works with agents run by other people or companies instead of only its own sub-agents: it finds them, sends them tasks and receives results, much like calling a service. Protocols such as A2A define the discovery and task exchange. Trust, auth and payment between parties become part of the design.
facts: Reuse capabilities you do not build or host
You cannot see or control the remote agent's internals
how: Discover a remote agent and read what it can do (for example an A2A Agent Card)
Authenticate with the scheme the remote agent declares
Send it a task and stream or poll for status
Answer follow-up questions if it needs more input
Use the returned result or artifact in your own flow
goodFor: Booking, purchasing or support with outside parties
Using a specialist agent as a service
watchOut: Trust and data sharing with third parties
Remote agents can fail, change or disappear
